config.name: plain_mixed_pair25
config.training_objective: local adversarial handoff with optional feedback, D auxiliaries, G read repair, and local feedback stability
config.state_diagnostic_note: whole-memory norms/saturation include raw coordinates when recent_points > 0

clock.features: sin/cos dyadic frequencies in radians per step; no raw time
clock.training: target index plus optional independent per-episode origin; shared by all sampled positions
clock.evaluation: cold starts at t=0; real-prefix continuation starts at t=prefix_length
clock.state: external integer counter only; no learned private G state

config.particle_policy: one fixed z per real episode, shared across sampled positions

proposal_adapter.input: raw D memory and unrefined point from the same particle and clock
proposal_adapter.clock: enters through the point reader; no extra adapter clock input
proposal_adapter.training: GAN gradients only; both reader passes connected
proposal_adapter.write: only final point; repaired memory is never stored

local_dynamics.branches: two parallel one-step D.write(G(M)) evaluations; same z/time
local_dynamics.gradient_ownership: D phase freezes G; G phase freezes D; no writer gradient from G loss
local_dynamics.scope: sampled local perturbations, not worst-case or global stability guarantee

config.fake_write_counting: maximum writes per phase, including parallel local stability branches; not sequential unroll depth
config.feedback_gradient: two G evaluations connected through frozen D writer in G phase; detached proposal in D phase
config.feedback_writer_d_gradient: weighted clean and explored judging histories
config.feedback_target: original next real point as recovery target
config.memory_timing: strictly before target; G optionally reads replaced last observation; D uses configured shared or clean memory, identical for both scores
config.penalty_domain: point coordinates and independent local pair coordinates; weighted default exact B-cap

local_pair.context: real prefix before both candidates; no future observations
local_pair.fake: two consecutive G outputs with one intervening D write; same particle
local_pair.branch: independent of point-loss exploration; never chained to that branch
local_pair.penalty: default exact B-cap in four candidate coordinates, cached prefix memory
local_pair.writer_gradients: D trains real prefix through pair score; G differentiates frozen generated write
local_pair.empty_prefix_targets: pair starts from M=0, compares generated first two points to real[0:2]
